hero_kpi_rationale: The 14.0% EBIT margin (excluding special items) in 2025 reflects Beiersdorf's structural ability to generate solid and stable operating profitability, despite a challenging macroeconomic environment. This indicator demonstrates the effectiveness of the business models within its premium brand portfolios (NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, tesa) and their resilience amid market uncertainties.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total group sales for the year.
kpis.description: Revenue reached €9.852 billion in 2025, flat compared to 2024 (€9.850 billion).
kpis.signal: Stabilized growth in 2025 amid a challenging macroeconomic context.

kpis.name: Organic Growth
kpis.explanation: Revenue growth excluding foreign exchange and acquisition effects.
kpis.description: Organic growth stood at 2.4% in 2025, down from 6.5% in 2024, impacted by economic uncertainties and commercial disruptions.
kpis.signal: Slowing organic growth in 2025 reflecting the macroeconomic environment.

kpis.name: EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit (excluding special items) divided by revenue.
kpis.description: EBIT margin excluding special items reached 14.0% in 2025, up from 13.9% in 2024, demonstrating the strength of the business model.
kpis.signal: Stable and resilient operating margin despite macroeconomic challenges.

kpis.name: Consumer EBIT Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin of the Consumer segment (excluding special items).
kpis.description: Consumer segment EBIT margin excluding special items reached 13.6% in 2025, up from 13.4% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Slight improvement in Consumer segment profitability.

kpis.name: R&D Investments
kpis.description: R&D expenses amounted to €365 million in 2025, up from €354 million in 2024, reflecting commitment to innovation.
kpis.signal: Ongoing support for innovation as a driver of future growth.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Investments in tangible and intangible assets.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reached €463 million in 2025, up from €437 million in 2024, including the construction of the new innovation center (€139 million).
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in assets, including the new innovation center in Hamburg.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees as of December 31 (headcount basis).
kpis.description: Total headcount stood at 22,399 employees (headcount) as of December 31, 2025, up from 22,267 in 2024.
kpis.signal: Stable workforce reflecting prudent adaptation to market conditions.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.description: Net profit reached €955 million in 2025, up from €928 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Growing net profitability despite stagnant revenues.

kpis.name: Consumer Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales from the consumer segment (NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Chantecaille, Hansaplast, Elastoplast, CURITAS).
kpis.description: The Consumer segment generated €8.176 billion in 2025, with nominal growth of 0.2% and organic growth of 2.5%.
kpis.signal: Core segment stabilized in 2025 with moderate organic growth.

kpis.name: tesa Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sales from the tesa segment (technological adhesive solutions for industry and consumers).
kpis.description: tesa achieved €1.676 billion in 2025, with a nominal decline of 0.7% but organic growth of 1.8%.
kpis.signal: Slight nominal decline offset by positive organic growth.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.description: Earnings per share reached €4.25 in 2025, up from €4.05 in 2024.
kpis.signal: Shareholder value creation despite a difficult market environment.

risks.title: Increased competition in the mass market
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the first part of the report, with strong language ("challenging mass-market environment"). The trend is upward due to persistent pressure on NIVEA. The Competition category is strategic for Beiersdorf.

risks.title: Dependence on scientific innovation
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, assertive language on Epicelline® and Thiamidol®. Trend stable, as innovation remains the growth driver. Key category for differentiation.

risks.title: Strategic realignment in China
risks.score_rationale: Repeatedly mentioned in the report, with intense language ("strategic realignment", "highly dynamic and unpredictable"). Trend upward, as China remains a critical challenge. Geopolitical category relevant due to regulatory and consumer risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of digital platforms
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in digital initiatives (NIVEA CONNECT), with moderate language. Trend upward with digital expansion. Category important but less central than competition.

risks.title: Increasing regulation on cosmetic ingredients
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but critical position in innovation mentions. Cautious language on market launches in China, India, and the United States. Trend upward with tightening standards. Strategic category.

risks.title: Dependence on emerging markets for growth
risks.score_rationale: Frequently mentioned in growth trends, with concerned language ("slowed in emerging markets"). Trend upward. Geopolitical category central to expansion.

risks.title: Reputation linked to sensitive social campaigns
risks.score_rationale: Risk raised through the "We are not alone" campaign, with engaged language. New trend. Moderately critical Reputation category.

risks.title: Integrity of industrial supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the context of tesa and production, moderate language. Trend stable. Industrial category related to operational risks.

ai_positioning.summary: No explicit mention of artificial intelligence in the provided documents. Innovation focuses on active ingredients (Epicelline, Thiamidol), product formulation, and environmental sustainability.
evidence: Innovation centered on revolutionary active ingredients (Epicelline, Thiamidol)
No reference to AI or advanced digital technologies
Priority given to dermatological and scientific research
Focus on physical devices and innovation centers (new 14,000 m² innovation center in Hamburg)
